title: fix(muya): keep the search highlight across a full re-render (#5651)
issueTitle: [Bug] Toggling a rendering preference clears the active search highlight
why: Reproducing the bug means changing a rendering preference, which is only possible in MarkText's separate Preferences window. The test is limited to keyboard and clicks inside the editor and can't open other windows, so the re-render that clears the highlight can't be triggered.
